title: Crane up city reveal
prompt_en: 21:9. Camera starts at street level on a busy crosswalk, then cranes up smoothly over rooftops revealing a city skyline at sunset. Warm haze, birds crossing frame, grand and hopeful.
prompt_zh: 21:9。镜头从繁忙斑马线的街面开始，平稳升起越过屋顶，展现日落时的城市天际线。温暖薄雾，鸟群掠过画面，宏大而充满希望。
why_it_works: One continuous, named camera move (crane up) structures the whole clip as a reveal.
